note: Small family campground in the town of Waucoma on the Little Turkey River, NE Iowa, with electric at the RV and tent sites (amperage not published). River tubing/canoeing and trout fishing nearby; a sandy river-access beach is on site but the RV sites sit inland behind a treeline. The operator's only web page is Facebook and it posts no rate. A camper wrote that it is small enough that a large RV takes up most of a spot. --Claude
summary: Facebook-only operator, no posted rate or engine. Google 4.3/39 with matching phone and RV Life $$ pass presence and price. Showers added as camper-reported; note trimmed. Hookups and site count stay as note-derived; nothing on an operator page confirms them.
flags: PRIVATE GATE: no posted rate anywhere I could read (Facebook HTML served to a logged-out reader shows only 'RV and tent campground', 581 followers; littleturkeyrivercampground.com does not resolve; Travel Iowa and The Dyrt guessed URLs 404, so stored inclusion_evidence's sources stayed unread). RV Life: 5.0 stars on 1 review, $$ (avg_rate $25), 20 sites vs stored 23. Google Maps: 4.3 on 39 reviews, phone +1 319-334-0135 (matches), open, 140 m from pin, no website. Gateway: none within 40 km. Passes presence (Google) and price (RV Life $$). Family has no reason to skip it on those.

LONG-STAY: I read it as an ordinary small park, not long-stay in character. The only hint is a 5-year-old Google review ('The regulars are also pretty chill'). No seasonal or monthly evidence, so test 2 doesn't apply.

RIG FIT, no agency limit: Google review 5 years old: 'It is smaller, so a large rv would take up most of a spot. Parking is a little scarce'. RV Life 2023 reviewer passed through on an overnight on 'compacted gravel with all the hookups' (rig length not stated). No stated limit; caveat in the note.

WATERFRONT holds at not waterfront: nearest pad ~44 m from the river through a continuous tree belt on imagery (river itself under canopy, narrow). Reviews say 'The turkey river is right there, so enjoyable to see' and 'scenery down by the river', which do not place any RV site in view; no operator photo reachable. Pin is at the south edge of the loop, about 80 m from the sites' centre (fine).
Website stays Facebook because no operator site exists; Facebook is not a website for the presence rule.
